title: Enrage
wikitext:
'''Enrage''' is a [[monster]] ability. Usually it grants 40% increased [[attack speed]], [[movement speed]] and [[damage]] for the duration of the enrage.<ref name="DevManifesto2.3.0"/><ref name="Phrecia enrage"/> Different enrage mechanics may also include damage reduction, increased [[character size]] or values higher or lower than the defaults.

Some monsters have it as an ability which has a cooldown, while sometimes it may have a scripted trigger (for example, enrage on [[low life]]).

==Monsters that Enrage==
* [[Bandit|Oak's Brute]]
* [[Q'uru]] and [[It That Fell]]
* [[Argus]] and [[Hephaeus, The Hammer]]
* [[Daresso, King of Swords]] and [[Ambrius, Legion Slayer]]
* [[Drought-Maddened Rhoa]]
* [[Skullbeak]]
* [[Y'ara'az]] and [[Slashing Horror]]
* [[The Black Mórrigan]]
* {{il|City Square Map}} bosses when a boss is killed

==Other sources of Enrage==
* [[Monster modifier]] ''Enraging'' (Periodically Enrages)
* Monster modifier ''Berserking'' (Enrages as Life Lost)
* [[Valdo's map]] modifier {{c|mod|Monsters Enrage on Low Life}}
* [[Ripper]] [[mercenary]]'s [[Enrage (mercenary skill)|Enrage]] skill
